message.content: Yuriko Yamamoto considers adding a user feedback section to her studio's homepage. According to the conversations provided, she expressed her desire for a user feedback section, stating, "Hey Li Hua! Could you help me design a user feedback section on my studio homepage? I think it would really help improve my services! 😊" Li Hua responded positively, indicating that they would be able to help her with this request, suggesting a simple form for users to leave comments or suggestions, along with a star rating system. Additionally, they discussed the inclusion of testimonials, which Yuriko believed would help build trust with new clients.
